blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 Paris Olympic double gold medalist Carlos Yulo, the first Filipino man and artistic gymnast to win an Olympic title, is back on familiar ground in Japan for the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games alongside his younger brother, who is making his Asiad debut. The 26-year-old from Manila made history two summers ago in Paris by winning apparatus golds in floor exercise and vault. It followed a nearly eight-year stay in Japan, where he honed his skills after arriving in 2016. “I really feel at home here,” said Yulo, seeking his first […]...
